promises.evidence: PARTIAL, AND THE ENTRANT DID NOT ASK. A COMMENT review went on ZAOstock #363 at 2026-09-27T20:26:37Z (pullrequestreview-5331913360), 8 days before this round closes: a real zone bug confirmed, the test file credited, and one specific change asked for, with React's own error text from a running build of head c44cfaab5db9c3d26b160a275a9463c757e94cf2. promises.text: Your written notes still come after the close, like every round.
promises.evidence: DECIDED: all of them, not none. The tension recorded earlier today was that one entrant got a measured mid-round review while others had not. The answer, from the Dotfiles lane citing Zaal's standing ruling of 2026-09-27 'always give feedback': every entry PR gets a measured review before the close, the same way. It was never a one-off - reviews had been going out under his grant since that morning. THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS ROW SAID THAT WAS DONE AT 20:46Z. IT WAS NOT. I counted any comment from the account as a review, which treated the claim reminder - payout logistics, posted on several PRs - as feedback on the code. The true state at 2026-09-27T20:46:25Z was 10 of 15, not 11 of 15: #322, #330, #336, #341 and #343 carried only the reminder. Caught by an independent reviewer reading every comment, not by me. The remaining five were posted as COMMENT reviews between 21:47:48Z and 21:50:52Z, and only then did every entry PR carry one. Re-verified by reading each pull request's REVIEWS rather than counting its comments: 15 entry PRs, 15 covered - 14 by a formal review and #353 by a substantive comment - 0 without. 10 at or before 20:46:59Z, 5 after. 16 open PRs, 1 ours and excluded, 15 entry PRs. This promise is about the WRITTEN NOTES at poidhz.com/feedback, which still come after the close, so it is not kept or broken by any of the above - the fairness problem the reviews created is what is settled here, and it is settled by doing all of them. If Vault or Zaal rules otherwise, it stops. SUPERSEDES an earlier draft of this row, written at 20:27Z the same afternoon, which recorded the same facts as an open watch and said the call was neither mine nor the reviewing lane's. It was answered within the hour, so only the answer reaches this file - but the row was a question first, and that is worth knowing if the answer is ever revisited.

promises.evidence: OWED AFTER THE 5 OCT CLOSE, NOT BROKEN NOW. This round's own text says written notes come after the close, so a claim without notes before then is the promise working, not failing. scripts/check-feedback-promises.py --round d05 --bounty 1421 exits 1 today and will keep exiting 1 until every claim in the field has a row, and scripts/mark-promise-kept.py refuses to write 'kept' while it does. That is the intended state until 5 October. AS OF 2026-09-27 the field is 9 claims - 8304, 8305, 8306, 8309, 8310, 8328, 8329, 8334, 8338 - of which 5 have notes and FOUR DO NOT: 8305, 8328, 8329, 8338. THAT LIST IS A STARTING POINT, NOT THE WORK. It is eight days out from the close and the field will grow: round four went from five claims to six 21 minutes before its deadline, and a rehearsal recorded at 15:4x that day said 'the field at the close is exactly those 5' - correct when measured, wrong an hour later. So on 5 October, re-run the gate and work its list, do not work this one. This line exists so nobody starts from zero, not so anybody starts from four. Written by hand. No script marks a forward-looking note - mark-promise-kept.py only writes on a passing gate, and saying otherwise is the error this ledger recorded earlier today.

promises.evidence: PUBLISHED COPY EDITED AFTER THE FACT, 2026-09-27, recorded here because editing notes people may already have read needs a reason on the record. An independent reviewer found that the ranking guard catches superlatives but not comparisons, and that a LIVE page (coolhat, d04) carried the headline 'This travelled further than anything else in the round, by a distance' - ranking one entrant against the field publicly, during judging, before any result. A scan of all five rounds found seven such phrases. The rule exists to stop ranking BEFORE a result, so three were rewritten and two deliberately left. REWRITTEN: d04 coolhat's headline; d04 assay, which also stated another entrant's view count on assay's own page (round four is closed but undecided); d05 metismuse (round five is open); d03 taku0x, a non-winner ranked against the field. Each keeps the fact and drops the comparison. LEFT ALONE: d02 assay 'the one thing in the kit nobody else opened' and d03 pascaline 'Nobody else has that' / 'nobody else can get'. Both rounds are decided and both describe the winner's own edge, so no result is being pre-announced - and rewriting a winner's published notes after the fact is its own problem. NOT ENFORCED BY THE GUARD: all five of these still pass COMPARISON_PHRASES, which is deliberately narrow because a broad version also refused a d03 kmacb.eth line that compares a demonstration to arguments rather than to entrants. Ruling from the Dotfiles lane; reverse it and the three rewrites revert with it.
